name: Data lineage graph display and browsing system

mentions.name: Data lineage graph display and browsing system
mentions.description: A system for displaying and browsing through data lineage graphs, which motivated building the Eland graph layout library after existing layout libraries proved unsuitable for the author's needs.
mentions.problem: Existing graph layout libraries don't do quite what is needed for rendering data lineage graphs.
mentions.source_excerpt: The reason I need all of this is that I'm working on a system to display and browse through data lineage graphs. I've noticed through experience that existing graph layout libraries don't do quite what I need, so I ended up building my own.
